responsibility: Declares the Rust AST-to-HIR lowering machinery for types, generic parameters, bounds, and where-clause entries. It provides dedicated visitors for type paths, qualified paths in types, general types, generic parameter nodes, type-param bounds, and where-clause items, with helper translate entry points that lower nested type structure, bare function types, references, arrays, trait bounds, lifetime bounds, and generic defaults into the HIR type system. This header is the central interface for all type-family lowering used by item, expression, and impl lowerers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the family of type-related lowerers—type/path translators, generic-parameter and bound lowerers, and where-clause lowering helpers—while rust-ast-lower-type.cc supplies the concrete visit-method implementations for those interfaces.
